meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Benchling 平台上的实验室数据录入与查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管理研发数据,想自动同步和查询。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data entry and queries on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab uses Benchling and needs automated data entry and lookup.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Benchling 的 Python SDK 和 v2 API 替你操作实验室数据:创建 DNA/RNA 等注册实体、管理样品容器与库存、建电子实验记录条目、发起或更新工作流任务,也能查询数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你提到 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API,或要把实验室数据自动化(如序列实体、库存、电子实验记录等)时触发。

say.text: 用 BENCHLING_API_KEY 连我的租户,先确认凭据有效
在 Benchling 建一条名为 My Plasmid 的环状 DNA 序列
把 Sample Tube 001 转移到 Freezer Box A1

howto.what_en: Claude can use the Benchling Python SDK and v2 API to work with lab data: create DNA/RNA registry entities, manage samples, containers and inventory, build ELN entries, run workflow tasks, and query the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Use when integrating the benchling-sdk or v2 API, or automating lab data such as sequences, inventory, ELN entries and workflows.

say_en.text: Connect to my tenant with BENCHLING_API_KEY and verify the credentials
Create a circular DNA sequence named My Plasmid in Benchling
Transfer Sample Tube 001 to Freezer Box A1
